verification_metadata.notes: Manual verification of all 76 detected issues across kernel versions

key_findings: Overall precision of 47.368% indicates significant false positive rate
Newer kernel (v6.0) shows better precision (50%) than older v5.0 (25%)
No issues detected in v3.0 and v4.0 - pattern may not exist in those versions
34 true positives in v6.0 represent real unchecked error vulnerabilities
2 true positives in v5.0 represent opportunities for backport fixes

checker_performance.recommendation: Refine AST matchers to reduce false positives while maintaining true positive detection

immediate_actions: Review false positive patterns to identify common causes
Refine checker logic to exclude benign unchecked error cases
Investigate why v5.0 has lower precision than v6.0
Analyze the 36 true positives for potential CVE reporting
future_improvements: Add context-aware analysis to distinguish critical vs. non-critical unchecked errors
Implement dataflow analysis to track actual error propagation
Create test suite based on true positive patterns
Extend pattern database with additional kernel bug commits
